reviews.title: Looks Great!
reviews.comment: I haven't been a real big fan of Street Fighter since the 90's consoles but this is all about the view. The view looks great! I'm kind of curious about how long these last. If it's going to last as long as the tower. So far I would state that this is one of the best things you can throw in a dull tower case to make it stand out. I would like to see these backgrounds in with other games on them though.
reviews.author: Dan

reviews.title: NOT a display screen
reviews.comment: This is NOT a display screen that allows you to display your own images, it is just an image of D.Va from Overwatch that lights up. You CANNOT customize image. A waste of money and a manipulative Amazon listing. Scam, do not buy.
reviews.author: Chantel Wilson-Whittier

reviews.title: Surprise
reviews.comment: Im dyslexic and thought this was an LCD display and just thought they made a bold choice for what the pictures were, so u can imagine my surprise when I opened the box and it was anime cheeks. BUT HOWEVER my gooner homie loved this and it does add a lil extra kick to ur PCs asthetic.
